_README: Each 1982 structure of the model (status "in model") against the footprints of the present-day 3D model (LandsD, survey date not established): the share of its outline a present-day building covers. gone < 20 %, built over >= 50 % ("a building stands on this footprint now, not necessarily the same one"), partly in between, not covered = outside the downloaded sheets. Absence at the survey date, never a demolition date. present_3d.py.
survey: photographed between mid-2021 and February 2024: read off the model's own ground photo (SOURCES.md 5ag); LandsD gives no date
source: LandsD 3D Visualisation Map (Individualised models), CSDI landsd_rcd_1671676915450_88604 (SOURCES.md 5ag, S43)
